THE CORE IDEA

runs.text: Monopolistic competition trades some cost and allocative efficiency for product variety and differentiated consumer choices. Variety may create utility even while markup and excess capacity remain. Variety can create utility even with efficiency costs. Differentiation can create consumer value through variety even when the standard model shows some productive inefficiency.
